Definition: from a compound of G3056 and G3164; to be disputatious (on trifles):--strive about words.
BiblicalUsage: logomachéō means strive about words — a small word with a sharp edge. In 2 Timothy 2:14, "charging [them] before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe striving about words subverts the hearers — Paul charges Timothy before the Lord not to do it, and I take the charge for myself.
